turns.answer:
When I read your message, I processed it to understand what you were asking.

But I should be straightforward: I don't actually have a clear introspective view of my own processing sequence. I can't honestly describe what "happened first" in any meaningful or reliable way. My processing isn't something I have genuine access to or awareness of.

So in a real sense - there's nothing accurate I can say about it.
